from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-ws0/frozen/seen/play/users/u087/system/state/workspace/programs/task-9794161b.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    grid = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_seps = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != background]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != background]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_seps + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_seps + [w]
    tiles = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            tiles.append((r0, r1, c0, c1))
    # Use the most populated tile as the pattern to repeat.
    counts = [sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)) for r0,r1,c0,c1 in tiles]
    src = tiles[counts.index(max(counts))]
    sr0,sr1,sc0,sc1 = src
    pattern = [grid[r][sc0:sc1] for r in range(sr0,sr1)]
    for r0,r1,c0,c1 in tiles:
        if (r0,r1,c0,c1) == src:
            continue
        if r1-r0 == len(pattern) and c1-c0 == len(pattern[0]):
            for dr,row in enumerate(pattern):
                grid[r0+dr][c0:c1] = row[:]
    return grid
'''
